<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-58-53" status="unreviewed"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs gter</rs> gyi gzhung <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b4"/>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> las rang rigs 'phen pa bzhi dang | gzhan rigs 'phen pa bcu bzhir bshad la | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> las rang rigs 'phen pa lnga gzhan rigs 'phen pa bcu drug tu bshad pa'i don <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6828">slob dpon phyogs glang gsar ma byams pa mgon po</rs>s bshad pa ltar na |
   <lg>      <l>me dang ba mo spu lung dang ||</l>
         <l>ba mo'i spu long ltos bcas kyis ||</l>
         <l>grang reg tsan me du ba dang ||</l>
         <l>tsan du nges pa <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b5"/> rim pa bzhin||</l>
         <l>'gog pa'i rang rigs 'phen pa lnga ||</l>
         <l>'di yang dpyad par bya ba yin |</l></lg>
      
       lnga po de la ba mo'i spu long gis tsan dan gyi du ba 'gog ma mi 'thad la/ltos pas nges pa 'gog pa'ang bcu gnyis po'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/gsum mam phan tshun gnyis ka rtsis na drug yin no||

       <lg>  <l>[]yang gzhan rigs 'phen pa'ang /</l>
         <l>me dang du bas ma reg <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b6"/> dang /</l>
         <l>me dang grang bas spu long dud||</l>
         <l>shing dang me med shab du med||</l>
         <l>spu long bye brag yod me med||</l>
         <l>sha ba shing du thal ba ste||</l></lg>
         bzlog pas bcu drug gzhan rigs 'phen zhes bya ste/de la dang po me ba reg dang ||du bas ma reg 'gog pa gnyis rung la/mes spu long 'gog pa grang pas dud pa 'gog pa gnyis gnad gcig pas gang rung gcig mi <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b7"/>'thad cing | shing med pas shab med 'phen pa dang bzhi/sha pas shing du thal ba 'phen pa dang lnga du ba yod pas me yod par thal ba dang drug[]me med pas du med du thal ba 'phen pa dang bdun po phan tshun bzlog pas bcu bzhir 'gyur gyi spu long gi bye  brag gis me 'gog pa'ang mi rig te/sngar rang rgyud kyi rtags kyi grangs nges bstan pa des shes par nus pa <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="60a1"/>yin no ||</seg></TEI>
